nodes.name: Approved follow-up event
nodes.notes: Only accepts requests with the right x-automation-key header (the "LeadPilot backend key" credential). Others get 403.

nodes.name: Check the event
nodes.notes: Checks the event. Delivery must be "simulated".

nodes.name: Ask: still approved?
nodes.notes: CHECK FIRST, DELIVER SECOND: the backend is the source of truth for the follow-up status.

nodes.name: Deliver or stop?
nodes.notes: approved: deliver. sent: duplicate, stop quietly. anything else: fail (escalate).

nodes.name: Simulated delivery (note on dashboard)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ executionId: String($execution.id), type: 'automation', message: $('Check the event').item.json.message, leadId: $('Check the event').item.json.leadId }) }}

nodes.notes: SIMULATED: instead of emailing the customer, write a note on the dashboard. A real email node replaces this one later.

nodes.name: Mark as sent
nodes.notes: Safe to retry: the backend never marks a follow-up as sent twice.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ executionId: String($execution.id), workflow: 'Send approved follow-up', leadId: $('Check the event').item.json.leadId, status: 'success', attempts: 1, maxAttempts: 3 }) }}
